semantic_state.label: Human Participant
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Human participants retain control over consequential product and ontology choices.

forbidden_collapse.context: Participation is not ownership or authority.

semantic_state.label: Machine Collaborator
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Machine collaborators operate inside declared source, output, and authority boundaries.

forbidden_collapse.context: Machine output is not owner meaning or authority.

semantic_state.label: Ontology Steward
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The Ontology Steward maintains identities, source bindings, relation rules, validation, and residue without becoming the source meaning owner.

forbidden_collapse.context: Stewardship is not source ownership, promotion authority, or product ownership.

semantic_state.label: Work Owner
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Source and work owners remain distinct from ontology tooling and evidence producers.

forbidden_collapse.context: Ownership is not automatic execution or publication authority.

semantic_state.label: Bounded Ontology Retrieval
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Consumers should use bounded logical identities instead of arbitrary filesystem reach.
semantic_state.scope: Product capability; interface and runtime remain unimplemented.

forbidden_collapse.context: A product requirement is not a working query runtime.

semantic_state.label: Deterministic Ontology Validation
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Equal admitted material produces equal material identity and stable validation status.
semantic_state.scope: Product capability; this package demonstrates only its own check contract.

forbidden_collapse.context: Validation PASS is not promotion, product proof, or runtime conformance.

semantic_state.label: Durable Ontology Epoch Reconciliation
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: A stale registration can remain fail-closed and still yield one bounded, durable, reviewable candidate epoch without rewriting admitted bytes or inferring promotion.
semantic_state.scope: Product capability design selected by the owner; system realization, provider binding, recovery proof, and admission remain separate.

forbidden_collapse.context: A durable candidate epoch is not current registration, semantic repair, admission, promotion, or activation.

semantic_state.label: Exact Source Admission
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The product preserves exact source identities, roles, and ownership before mapping meaning.
semantic_state.scope: Product capability, not current runtime proof.

forbidden_collapse.context: Admission does not promote or reinterpret source meaning.

semantic_state.label: Typed Relational Meaning
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The product preserves typed nodes, relations, provenance, confidence, posture, and residue.
semantic_state.scope: Product capability, not current runtime proof.

forbidden_collapse.context: Typed representation does not make a claim canonical.

semantic_state.label: Validate The Ontology Product Foundation
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The Goal seeks exact Product, Thesis, Project, and Goal identity closure while preserving the CyberAlchemy subproduct relationship.
semantic_state.scope: Candidate product-ontology Goal identity; not achieved and not externally Goal-package validated.

forbidden_collapse.context: Writing or validating candidate files does not prove Goal achievement.

semantic_state.label: Ontology Inspectability
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Source, relation, confidence, posture, and residue evidence are intended to make ontology use reviewable.

forbidden_collapse.context: Available evidence is not proof that people can understand it efficiently.

semantic_state.label: Meaning Continuity
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Stable typed records and sources are intended to reduce meaning reconstruction across sessions and tools.

forbidden_collapse.context: Intended continuity is not observed burden reduction.

semantic_state.label: Project-Owned Ontology
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: A project-owned contract is intended to keep adapters and runtimes replaceable.

forbidden_collapse.context: A product boundary is not evidence that Arcanum has been replaced.

semantic_state.label: Reviewable Ontology Change
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Deterministic identity and visible residue are intended to make ontology evolution reviewable rather than silent.

forbidden_collapse.context: Reviewability does not grant acceptance or promotion authority.

semantic_state.label: Governed Ontology Package
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The product's minimum durable output is an independently validatable ontology package rather than an accumulating run receipt.

forbidden_collapse.context: A package is not source authority or a runtime service.

semantic_state.label: Fragmented Project Meaning
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Indexes and one-off graphs do not by themselves preserve typed meaning, source ownership, contradictions, residue, or evolution identity.
semantic_state.scope: Problem addressed by the Ontology Product.

forbidden_collapse.context: Not evidence that every project needs the product or will obtain measurable value.

semantic_state.label: CyberAlchemy
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: CyberAlchemy is the parent product whose first-order principles constrain the Ontology Product subproduct.
semantic_state.scope: Parent-product identity only; its complete product ontology is owned elsewhere.

forbidden_collapse.context: Not a duplicate parent product definition or a claim that this package owns CyberAlchemy as a whole.

semantic_state.label: CyberAlchemy Ontology Product
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The Ontology Product is a CyberAlchemy subproduct dedicated to durable, typed, source-bound ontology work.
semantic_state.scope: Private candidate product identity and business meaning; runtime realization is excluded.

forbidden_collapse.context: Not an implemented runtime, public product, or authority over source meaning.

semantic_state.label: Ontology Product Foundation Project
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The Project coordinates the thesis, Goal, evidence, residue, design, and later runtime work under one identity.
semantic_state.scope: Candidate product-ontology Project identity; external Goal-package carrier validation is not evaluated.

forbidden_collapse.context: Project membership does not authorize implementation, Goal achievement, or successor work.

semantic_state.label: Ontology Realizations Remain Replaceable
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: No adapter, runtime, or external capability may become the meaning owner merely because it materializes or queries the ontology.
semantic_state.scope: First-order product rule; runtime enforcement absent.

forbidden_collapse.context: The rule is not evidence that any current dependency has been replaced.

semantic_state.label: Source Meaning Retains Authority
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: No ontology node, relation, validator, receipt, or runtime may silently redefine its source authority.

forbidden_collapse.context: The rule does not itself enforce source authority at runtime.

semantic_state.label: Ontology Residue Remains Visible
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: The product must not smooth contradiction, drift, absence, uncertainty, or deferred work into a complete-looking graph.

forbidden_collapse.context: Visible residue is not resolution or permission to ignore the blocker.

semantic_state.label: Project-Owned Meaning Continuity
semantic_state.definition_or_claim: Owner-selected source meaning can become a durable, typed, source-bound, independently validatable ontology without transferring meaning authority to the ontology or runtime.

forbidden_collapse.context: A validated thesis record is not product realization or effectiveness proof.
